probeDiagnosis.basis: Each no-hit foot target has no nearer occluder and the corresponding direct canvas shows visible footwear; source computes one nearest authored-shoe vertex to the foot bone and traces only to that exact endpoint. This supports a point/edge-grazing miss, not poor framing; exact vertex/triangle intersection was not recorded, so edge grazing remains likely rather than proven.
Mrs back-interact PNG shows counter overlapping the right lower leg/foot area; do not infer floor/contact from image.

pixelSampler.basis: foot sample is bounds-center x/z at bounds.min.y + 6% body height, not an authored foot/shoe point. Mrs front-interact sampled [233,229,222] against [233,229,221] (contrast 1), i.e. background/floor pixel; screenshot has clear shoes. The 16 low feet-contrast rows therefore do not establish missing actor pixels.

npcGameplay.nativeVenueNpcWalkGait: No current production gait path. Venue NPCs are static non-live CrowdPerson specs; canonical eligibility accepts only pose undefined/null/'stand'. nativeNpcPose() maps matching state.activeAction activity IDs to idle/interact, and update() calls body.show(pose,false); stepCrowd() advances live player-peer easing and active NPC talk/jaw only. loadGameBody requests idle/walk/interact and native pose support includes walk, but venue NPC code never drives native NPC stride/walk.
npcGameplay.otherActorGait: Live peer players use separate stand/walk figures; stepCrowd() advances transforms and switches figures as peer.stride changes.

nativeLookAdmission.preparedNativeSubset: body man/woman; outfit casual/office; fabric plain; hair lowcut/low-cut/fade/classic/afro/curls; no accessories or wearables; adult, average height/build. Face/expression and palette colors must be in LOOK_OPTIONS; skin1-7 are mapped. Venue admits at most two static eligible NPCs after WebGL2/bodyAllowed gate.
nativeLookAdmission.fallback: Complete native-ineligible or incomplete looks go through loadBody legacy/procedural fallback. This is no claim of complete NPC/look coverage.
